entities.name: DDX6
observations: The 483-aa query sequence is an exact sequence match to UniProt P54823, mouse DDX6, with 100% identity and full-length coverage.
DDX6 is a DEAD-box ATP-dependent RNA helicase; curated EC assignment is EC 3.6.4.13.
The sequence contains a Q motif, helicase ATP-binding/DEAD domain, DEAD motif, and Helicase_C domain.
Curated homologs localize DDX6 to cytoplasm, P-bodies, nucleus, and stress-related cytoplasmic ribonucleoprotein granules.
DDX6 participates in RNA metabolism, translational repression, P-body assembly, and mRNA decapping complexes.

entities.name: ATP hydrolysis by DDX6
observations: Curated Rhea mapping is RHEA:13065, corresponding to ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate + H+.

ATP hydrolysis supplies energy for DEAD-box RNA helicase conformational cycling and RNA remodeling; the sequence evidence supports ATPase activity, while exact RNA substrate specificity is not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: DDX6 sequence properties
observations: The protein is 483 aa with predicted molecular mass 54.19 kDa and theoretical pI 8.85.
The N-terminal region is compositionally biased/disordered, while the conserved helicase core occupies approximately residues 96-468.
